snippet.title: Virtual Duck Hunt – Official VR Trailer | Meta Quest Arcade Shooter
snippet.description:
Virtual Duck Hunt is a fast-paced VR arcade shooter inspired by classic retro duck hunting games.

https://www.meta.com/experiences/app/6258640254239612/?utm_source=oculus&utm_medium=share

Step into virtual reality, grab your gun, and test your reflexes as you shoot ducks, chase high scores, and climb global leaderboards. Designed for quick sessions and addictive gameplay, Virtual Duck Hunt blends old-school arcade fun with modern VR immersion.

🎮 Features:
• Arcade-style VR shooting
• Global leaderboards
• Retro-inspired gameplay
• Regular updates and improvements
• Available on Meta Quest

🔥 Recently updated with a major graphical overhaul

▶️ Available now on Meta Quest

📌 Follow the project:
• Discord: https://discord.gg/TFk7Myd7
• Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/virtual_duck_hunt/

#VirtualDuckHunt
